text: Integer views shall fit wholly within one actual integer object's/leaf's representation bytes, including permitted smaller interior-byte views. They shall not span fields, include padding, or inspect data-pointer/function-reference encodings. Stores shall update only their requested integer representation bytes without changing declared type.
